author: pre-registration lane
scope_note: Expected outputs for the 8 records of data/research/styling-inci/v1.0/capture/unseen-r3.json, derived only from those records (INCI, claims with tiers, directions, pack text) under styling-classification-standard.md v0.1, lexicon v0.1, property set v0, charter and the rulings ledger (SD1-SD5, D1-D8b, PH1-1..16, PH2-1..12). Firmness: 'firm' = the rule determines the value unambiguously from the record; 'soft' = judgment involved (alternatives listed). 'UNDETERMINED' = the standard does not decide the value; treated as a finding. Keys named informational_* are NOT scoring targets: for evidence_gate records the standard emits no Styling values (standard 4.7), and for leave_in/oil/heat_protectant/dry_shampoo/mixed_promise records Styling properties are optional and informational_and_non_authoritative.

conventions.ranks: 1-based, comma split at bracket depth 0 (lexicon 0.4). Recounted 2026-10-12: slots 3, 7, 8 have 7, 22, 22 items, not the inci_item_count values 8, 23, 24 in the capture file (capture defect, moves nothing).
conventions.T_S: full Mask rule (PH2-9, lexicon 0.2): earliest of fragrance, declared allergen/aroma chemical, PR-1 preservative, PR-2 booster only when a PR-1 is declared, CH-1 chelator
conventions.T_LI: LI 3.1.1 capped list plus other Annex V preservatives; fragrance/allergens never eligible (LI T17); statuses plausible/implausible/vacuous/none_visible

summary.firmness: soft (alternative: oil by D2 name rule if the water-based-serum exception is not applied)

informational_counterfactual_if_C1C2_pro.pair_rule: 3.4(ii) aqueous, styling directly (PH2-1); if li_function were yes, 3.4(iii) LI G0 excluded_styling_first, same route; not held

informational_counterfactual_if_C1C2_pro.provides_heat_protection: false (not_claimed; 'mit Lockenstab stylen' is a styling instruction)

rule_gaps: Lexicon FX-2c corroboration (ii) asks for 'no RH-1 member anywhere'. Acrylates/Beheneth-25 Methacrylate Copolymer is an associative thickener in practice but falls into the FX-U catch-all ('any vinyl/acrylate copolymer not named'), not RH-1, so it does not block corroboration. A thickener-shaped copolymer neither blocks FX-2c nor is read as rheology.
Polyurethane-34 (and other non-PU-14 polyurethanes) is FX-U by default; a beach spray resting on it alone would read hold_route ambiguous.

records.product: Balea Styling Finishing Stick (Fixierungsbürste), 10 ml, liquid with mascara wand
records.intended_trap: target_zone surface/hairline product (baby hairs, flyaways, brows), subtype_candidate smoothing_styler; frizz-taming promise on a fixative formula (Leave-in border scope under PH2-1); weight claim 'ohne zu beschweren' vs a cationic-guar formula.
records.trap_caught: Not exercised. dm states Verwendungshinweise 'keine vorhanden' and the capture's directions are a paraphrase of the product description plus an observation of the wand. LI 2.4 rule 1: a paraphrase is not a capture. S0 input 2 fails, so no Styling values are emitted. The surface/hairline value stays untested. Packet-builder risk: if the paraphrase enters the sealed S0 packet as 'verbatim directions', lanes will run S0 and diverge (see counterfactual).

informational_counterfactual_if_directio.li_function: UNDETERMINED - 'fixiert ... Frizz' / 'Bändigt ... Frizz' names frizz control (an LI 2.1 smoothing/anti-frizz function => yes) but the verb is fixing (hold => no). The tag definition does not say which word governs.
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.if_li_function_no: 3.1 runs (frizz/flyaway lead) but name is not Öl/Serum; 3.4(ii) => styling directly
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.if_li_function_yes: 3.4(iii) LI G0 with T_LI none_visible: VP/VA r4 vs cationic guars r7 (above T_S) and r9 (below Parfum). If the guars read as LI COND moderate (cationic-polymer film route) the T15 reading is 'not thin' => in_category (incidental_film) => D6 fails (real hold: VP/VA) => leave_in. If they read thin => excluded_styling_first (C1 positioning 'fixiert') => styling, not held. UNDETERMINED: the T15/COND reading with no readable T_LI and two cationic guars straddling Parfum.
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.subtype: UNDETERMINED - rule 2 (hairline => gel) needs directions leading with baby hair/brows; without them, job 'flyaway control on dry hair' + dry_finish points to shine_finish; capture guess smoothing_styler does not fit (no heat/damp moment)
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.result_mechanisms: fixative_film [VP/VA Copolymer r4] - 'VPVA COPOLYMER' read as an unambiguous alias of VP/VA Copolymer (lexicon 0.4 item 4, logged as transcription repair). A lane that refuses the alias reads it FX-U => hold_route ambiguous.
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.weight: medium (one family: (e) Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride r7 above T_S; Guar HPTC r9 below)
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.weight_claim_conflict: yes - C2 house brand 'Ohne zu verkleben oder zu beschweren' vs medium
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.buildup_note: fires (limb 1: Hydroxypropyl Guar HPTC r7 = LI 7.6 permanent_cationic above T_S; PH2-5)
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.chaarlie_hold_level: 1 (C2 house brand 'leichte Fixierung', strength word 'leicht'; moderate, house-brand review) - soft: 'Fixierung' not 'Halt'
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.flexibility: unbekannt ('ohne zu verkleben' is not a flex word, PH1-5)
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.finish: unbekannt ('perfektes Finish', 'nicht fettend' are not finish words)
informational_counterfactual_if_directio.primary_job: frizz_control (gate: fixative_film counts as 'a film'), secondary hold_fix

rule_gaps: li_function tag has no tie rule for a lead promise that fixes frizz (hold verb + anti-frizz object).
T15 'thin' test via LI COND has no stated reading when T_LI is none_visible and the only conditioning is cationic guar ranked around Parfum.
Subtype rule 2 says 'gel-type shaping product' without defining gel-type for a liquid wand product.

records.product: GUHL Locken Pflege & Styling 3in1 (Haarkur, Conditioner & Lockencreme), 200 ml, cream
records.intended_trap: 'Lockencreme' name with no fixative (D7 must not fire; Cantu/HASK pattern), a rinse-out-capable 3in1 conditioner base, a C3-only heat claim, and a 'Pflege & Styling' co-lead.
records.trap_caught: Yes. Never routes to Styling: the co-equal 'Pflege & Styling' lead makes the class mixed; PH1-12 runs D7 first and D7 fails (no fixative-class polymer anywhere; Hydrolyzed Corn Starch is NF-1, not FX) => mixed_promise. Under any non-mixed reading the letter gives leave_in (real care blocks D6). The heat claim is C3 and never counts.

T_LI.note: tail r19-r24 = Benzoic Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate (a), Parfum, Linalyl Acetate, TAHN (b): closed set only (LI 3.1.1 clause 6). No route depends on it: D7 limb 1 fails on the whole list.
